Name: Glow Artisan
Description: A puzzle game of sliding and rotating coloured tiles until they complete a glowing pattern.

Achievements.Name: Gold Rush
Achievements.Description: Earn a Gold Move Medal on any puzzle.

Achievements.Name: Time is on Your Side
Achievements.Description: Earn a Gold Time Medal on any puzzle.

Achievements.Name: A First Time for Everything
Achievements.Description: Earn the first Trophy Piece in Apprentice difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Two Out of Four Ain't Bad
Achievements.Description: Earn second Trophy Piece in Apprentice difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Third Time's a Charm
Achievements.Description: Earn third Trophy Piece in Apprentice difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Clear a Space on the Mantle
Take a Puzzling Vacation
Achievements.Description: Unlock and solve all Bonus Puzzles.

Achievements.Name: Slick Moves
Achievements.Description: Earn 50% of all Gold Move Medals.

Achievements.Name: Halftime Show
Achievements.Description: Earn 50% of all Gold Time Medals.

Achievements.Name: Master of Moves
Achievements.Description: Earn Gold Move Medals for every puzzle in the game, including Bonus Puzzles.

Achievements.Name: Lord of Time
Achievements.Description: Earn Gold Time Medals for every puzzle in the game, including Bonus Puzzles.

Achievements.Name: ... It'll Last Longer
Achievements.Description: Create a Picture Puzzle in Create Mode.

Achievements.Name: Don't Rush an Artist
Achievements.Description: Take over 7 minutes to create a really awesome 5x5 or 8x6 puzzle.
